title: Arrival Grace, Change Limits and Missed-Appointment Fees for Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Specimen Collection Appointments — appointment terms by visit type.** The figures below are the published arrival, change and missed-appointment terms of each visit type.

| Visit type | Arrival grace (minutes) | Arrival after the grace period | Most reschedules per visit | Free-change notice (hours) | Late-cancellation fee (USD) | No-show fee (USD) | No-shows that bar new bookings | No-show lookback (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | 0 | Not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (never restricted) | 365 |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | 10 | Served as a walk-in | 3 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (never restricted) | 365 |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | 10 | Served as a walk-in | 3 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (never restricted) | 365 |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | 15 | Rebooking required | 2 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (never restricted) | 365 |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | 10 | Rebooking required | 3 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (never restricted) | 365 |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | 15 | Recorded as a no-show | 2 | 24 | 40.00 | 60.00 | 2 | 365 |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | 0 | Not applicable | 2 | 12 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (never restricted) | 365 |

## Terms explained

1. **Arrival grace** — the minutes after the appointment start (or the start of the arrival window) during which an arrival still counts as on time.
2. **Arrival after the grace period** — what happens to an arrival after the grace period: served as a walk-in, a new booking is required, the visit is recorded as a no-show, or the term does not apply to the visit type.
3. **Most reschedules per visit** — the maximum number of times one visit can be moved to another date or time.
4. **Free-change notice** — the hours before the appointment start at or beyond which a patient cancellation carries no fee; 0 means a cancellation is always free.
5. **Late-cancellation fee** — the published fee for a patient cancellation made with less than the free-change notice; 0.00 means none.
6. **No-show fee** — the published fee for a visit recorded as a no-show; 0.00 means none.
7. **No-shows that bar new bookings** — the number of no-shows within the lookback period that bars new bookings of the visit type; 0 means the visit type is never restricted.
8. **No-show lookback** — the calendar days, counted back from the booking date, over which no-shows are counted for that restriction.

## Reading the terms (hypothetical arrivals)

- A Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment starting at 08:00: arrival at 08:05 is within the 10-minute grace and counts as on time; arrival at 08:25 is after the grace period, and the patient is served as a walk-in.
- A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit with a window starting at 09:00: a patient present at 09:10 is within the 15-minute grace; a patient still not present when the 15-minute grace period has ended falls on the "recorded as a no-show" term.
- Only the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit carries a non-zero published late-cancellation fee, no-show fee and no-show restriction count.
